title: Decompose the webview provider into testable services
description:
After correctness fixes are protected by tests, reduce the provider's responsibilities without changing product behavior. Extract a typed message router and focused request, persistence, collection/import, history, and code-generation services behind narrow interfaces. The provider should own VS Code lifecycle and composition, not business rules or data transformations.

Centralize request normalization, structured errors, redaction, limits, and operation correlation so services cannot drift. Inject filesystem, SecretStorage, transport, clock, and UI boundaries to make unit tests deterministic. Establish clear ownership and disposal for listeners, queues, locks, and in-flight executions.

Move in small reviewable slices while keeping the regression suite green. Do not use this task to add deferred Postman-parity features or redesign the UI. Completion requires lower coupling, no circular dependencies, documented module boundaries, and focused tests that no longer require the full provider.

checklist.text: Map current provider responsibilities, side effects, dependencies, and regression coverage
Extract a typed message router with validation, correlation, acknowledgements, and shared error mapping
Extract focused request, persistence, collection/import, history, and code-generation services
Centralize normalization, redaction, validation limits, and structured domain errors
Inject transport, storage, secrets, filesystem, clock, and VS Code UI boundaries for deterministic tests
Define lifecycle ownership and dispose listeners, locks, queues, and executions exactly once
Document module boundaries and verify no circular dependencies or behavior regressions
